decisions.statement: Frames are drawn evenly across the clip.
The first frame and the last frame are among the frames drawn.
A single frame is drawn from the middle of the clip.
Asking for more frames than the clip has answers with every frame the clip has.
A frame reaches the model as a base64 `data:image/png` url.
The checklist is said after every frame rather than before those frames.
The model is asked at temperature zero.
`ffmpeg` missing from the path is said as that rather than as a spawn fault.

definition: a clip read frame by frame by the MLX vision model against a checklist
